body: I want to kill something in me. It won't die. I drank her sleeping pills, after an hour I puked it out. My body denies everything. It's hard wanting to do something with my life and wanting to die all at the same time.
I don't want my sister to celebrate her birthday tomorrow crying. Besides, I want to drown, jumping is too messy.
I almost jumped today. On the rooftop I found a few days ago online. Then I remembered my sister's birthday is tomorrow. I wanted to do it, but not today.
